reviews.x: Love this lip stain!  Tested some on the palm of my hand and it stayed on through 3 hand washes. Not only is it a unique and pretty tube, the gloss itself is beautiful with the flower in it, and it also feels good to wear. It goes on clear and immediately changes to a nice natural pink on my lips. My new favorite thing!

This product has a nice strong pink tint/color. I was very skeptical since its clear but it actually gave color!!! It feels more like a chapstick which is a plus and doesn't even feel like its there. Very balmy when you put it on. The scent is decent enough to live with. Though if you have chapped lips the color will fill into the lines and looks a bit weird. The mirror on the side was not a mirror you could use at all and was scratched up, at least mine was (I've heard people actually have a re

I am willingly giving this product 5 stars ✨, the lipstick is so cute and neat along with it being a very nice shade of pink, this color will actually look good on any skin color and I'm on the medium tan side. It's soft on the lips and keeps it moisturized. It smells amazing as well. Although it took a while to come in I'm still giving a 5 star review because I wasn't in a rush and I'm rather patient! Just keep in mind that international shipping will take a while due to weather and any inconve

reviews.t: Pretty color but leaves a plastic taste
reviews.x: I got the purple lipstick and the color is very pretty. My only complaint, so far, is that the lipstick leaves a plastic like taste even after wiping it off my lips. I think next time I'll try putting a chapstick or gloss coat over it to see if that will help with the plastic taste but right now it's a little too hard to ignore. Given the price, I think it's a cool product and I'm happy with the color.

reviews.t: Beware! Same look, difference in smell and taste!
reviews.x: OK, the only reason I gave it two stars is because of the taste/smell. This is the second time I've ordered Kailijumei, and the first time they came I loved them. Beautiful texture, color, and lightly perfumed scent, with no noticeable flavor. But this time, although the look, packaging, texture and color look the same, they both smell and taste like plastic. Very unpleasant to wear. I wish there was a better way to determine whether you're ordering the quality product or the cheap look-alike...

This is a good lip balm that goes on clear and turns bubblegum pink. I am fair completed. I like to dab it lightly on the apples of my cheeks on no makeup days for a little natural looking color. The real reason I love this product is that it's so fun to use! First, the tube is pretty and the mirror is a nice feature. The lipstick pops out at the press of a button. So satisfying! Then, of course, the clear lipstick with gold flecks and little flower inside is so pretty.

reviews.t: It is very smooth when applying and I love the color
reviews.x: This is probably the prettiest lipstick I have ever seen. It is very smooth when applying and I love the color. But the taste is HORRIBLE. If you can stand the taste of plastic and chemicals then by all means buy this. If you can't then I definitely do not recommend this. This taste gave me a horrible headache and the fact that it is like a stain, it doesn't come off your lips for the whole day so the taste doesn't go away either.

reviews.t: I think this is a fake.
reviews.x: The lipstick is not clear like all the photos show, it is such a dark pink that you can barely see the flower inside and it creates a very dark, freaky looking, unflattering stain on the lips. It does not work like all the videos I have seen. I am very disappointed because I saw many videos where the lipstick was beautiful and crystal clear and created a soft, flattering pink on the lips.

reviews.t: I do not get the purple flower like I ordered
reviews.x: First off, I do not get the purple flower like I ordered..Second the one I did get had the smallest most pathetic flower I've ever seen in it and when I accidentally licked my lips I was beyond disgust. Will never buy this again and will stick to the other brand of jelly lip sticks from now on..

I bought this as a birthday gift to my sister who doesn't wear a lot of makeup, works in the medical field, and wants to look put together without fussing around with makeup. This did the trick; she absolutely loved it! Gave the perfect tint, said that it gave her enough color that she didn't look 'dead.' The flower was lovely and the gold flecks added a nice touch.  I also bought baby-doll flower shade for myself. I will say the taste isn't very pleasant, hence the four-star. Also, if I added t

reviews.t: This is definitely a fun lipstick to play around with
reviews.x: This is definitely a fun lipstick to play around with.  The color is a little bright for me, but honestly it is exactly what I expected.  Do try to avoid letting the lipstick get too warm because it will make it less transparent, but it really does last for hours.  I also loved the makeup case, it doesn't pop open in my purse and I always have a mirror.  I did remove one star because of the taste, however.  They tried to cover it with some sort of berry flavor, but there is still a pretty distin

reviews.t: Beautiful, but not a huge fan of the stain color
reviews.x: This is a beautiful product. The packaging is nice and the lipstick itself is so interesting with the flower inside. It came as pictured. The lip tint is a little more pink than what I would've liked (and despite the different "shades" I think they're all pretty much the same lip stain color). I like something that's a little more red/maroon, but that's just personal preference. The stain definitely stays! Over all, it's a cute thing to add to your lipstick collection.

reviews.t: Bitter Taste & Toxic Smell, it's pretty tho
reviews.x: Bitter taste & smells like chemicals. I'm an all natural product person and this smells toxic. My lips tingle when I wear it. I do like the color and it  gets darker as you wear it. It's beautiful to look at. I think I will just keep it as a novelty item. Also.. giant lettering: MADE IN CHINA. I was looking for that info when I was purchasing and I couldn't find it. This lipstick made it all the way to Texas at the end of summer without melting ?? 🤔It's cute tho

This is a great product. My lips are sensitive and get itchy and peel with most lip glosses--NOT THIS ONE! I got the purple flower one and it is so good. Goes on well and there is a mirror on the lip gloss container which is great! The way the lip gloss comes out is great too--won't accidentally fall apart in my purse like some others. My daughter (three and a half) got to try a little and she thinks it is magical because it is so pretty.

I would absolutely, positively adore this thing. Everything about it is perfect from application to packaging and presentation. It smells great.  But when I put it on, a horrible, artificial bitter taste creeps into my mouth, I think it reminds me of rubber or motor oil. Hopefully I just got a bad one and other people are out there enjoying the heck out of theirs.

I normally do not write reviews. I was so excited to try this product. I opened it up and put it on right away.... except the taste was horrible. This product tastes like you smeared motor oil on your lips. Sadly, it did change my lips to a lovely color. I tried it a second time and I just cannot get past the taste. Throwing this one in the garbage. Money wasted.

reviews.t: Not worth its price! Better off buying the $1 from Wish!!!
reviews.x: The color gets deeper the more you apply. The taste of bitter petroleum jelly stays in your mouth. I thought it was really cool when I first bought it really it’s kind of boring. But great to use to moisten your lips before you put on a really dry mac lipstick. The packaging is different I like that it has a button and the lipstick comes shooting out like a toy .

Honestly not sure if it's fake, but if it is it must be just as good. Flower and gold flakes looked exactly as expected and went on pink. I think the original brand is supposed to smell good, if anything this has a slight vaseline smell/taste. Perfect for the price and I'm very happy with it!

I was hoping this would be the real deal. It has so many great reviews, however after receiving it and trying it there is a bitter chemical plastic taste so I may not actually continue to use this item. I will do more research next time before purchasing.

reviews.t: Pretty but headache inducing for me!
reviews.x: I don't like this product,it does what it says but it smells a little toxic and gives me a headache.I just don't know why,I liked it but stopped using it so it doesn't give me that uncomfortable headache,pretty package and lipstick though.

Love this Product. Bought it for the simple fact that I saw that it stains and last forever. Only bad part was that the lipstick was cloudy and had quite a few bubbles trapped inside so it was crystal clear to see the flower.
My lipstick was not completely clear-has a yellow tint for the clear part. There was absolutely no flavor & smelled a little of plastic... Cute to look at, but probably won't use it...
Too bright for my dark skin. Also, it leaves a weird reddish, uneven tint on my lower lip that's difficult to remove.

reviews.x: The only difference is that it's not as clear as shown bbut other than that it's fine.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the color-changing effect, describing it as a pretty, natural pink tint that lasts for hours.
The packaging and flower-in-the-tube design are widely praised as beautiful, cute, and fun to use.
A common complaint is a bad taste or chemical/plastic smell, with some reviewers finding it unbearable.
Several reviewers report receiving the wrong shade or a product that looks different from the photos, with some suspecting it is fake.
Some reviewers find the product moisturizing and gentle, even on sensitive lips.
